sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide — Platinum Roadmap, All 55 Trophies

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is the reward for everything else: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. There is no separate task — the last trophy you earn decides when this one unlocks, and for most players that is A Long Road at 100% completion.

steps.t: Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum unlocks automatically with the last one.
Plan A Long Road (100% completion) as the final push, since it is the usual last trophy before the platinum.
Do not use cheats on the trophy save — cheats disable trophies and saving, which would block the platinum.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The opening mission. Gone Fishing is the first story mission of the game, so this trophy comes naturally in the first hour — play the story from the start and it pops when the mission ends.

steps.t: Start a new game and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, from the beginning.
Follow the mission objectives as they appear; there is no optional requirement beyond finishing the mission.
The trophy pops when the mission completes — the first trophy of the run.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. While you play it, meditate at every meditation spot the moment you see one — the Chapter 1 spot is the one possibly missable trophy in the game, and there is no mission replay to go back for it.

steps.t: Play through all of Chapter 1's story missions in order until the chapter closes.
Meditate at every meditation spot you pass in Chapter 1 — one early spot is lost permanently once the chapter ends.
Make a manual save at the start of the chapter, since there is no mission replay and no New Game+.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. This is also the chapter where Jason and Lucia can both be played, which opens up most of the game's other trophies — use the chapter to start side content as it appears.

steps.t: Play through all of Chapter 2's story missions in order until the chapter closes.
Once both protagonists are playable, pick up side missions and activities as they appear — most trophies only open up from here.
Keep meditating at every spot you see; the counter carries across chapters.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. Two time-sensitive things live in this chapter: the race against Yago for Strangers & Freaks, and optional missions that feed A Long Road — do them the moment they appear instead of pushing the story forward.

steps.t: Play through all of Chapter 3's story missions in order until the chapter closes.
Start every stranger strand marker the moment it appears — the Chapter 3 race against Yago closes as the story moves on.
Take optional missions when they are offered; some close mid-story and feed the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. Heist trophies open up in Chapters 3–4, so by this chapter the crime side of the list is in full swing — rob, escape, and keep the manual saves going.

steps.t: Play through all of Chapter 4's story missions in order until the chapter closes.
Use the chapter to work on heist trophies — they open in Chapters 3 and 4.
Make a manual save before the final mission, since there is no mission replay.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story — the gold trophy for seeing the story through. After the credits, free roam stays open, so everything not yet earned can still be finished.

steps.t: Finish Chapters 1–4, then play the final mission to its end.
Save manually before the final mission — there is no mission replay to redo it.
After the credits, keep playing in free roam: all content outside the story stays available.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Named story missions cannot be skipped, so this trophy is unmissable as long as you play the story — just finish the mission when it comes up.

steps.t: Play the story until the Breakfast Run mission appears.
Complete the mission objectives as they are given.
The trophy pops when the mission ends; no extra requirement.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is a required story mission, so the trophy comes with normal story progress — finish the heist and it pops.

steps.t: Play the story until The Cartel Heist mission appears.
Complete the heist mission objectives as they are given.
The trophy pops when the mission ends; no extra requirement.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. A required story mission, so the trophy is unmissable in normal play — finish the mission when it comes up.

steps.t: Play the story until the Child's Play mission appears.
Complete the mission objectives as they are given.
The trophy pops when the mission ends; no extra requirement.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. A required story mission — finish it when it comes up and the trophy pops with the mission end.

steps.t: Play the story until the Headliners mission appears.
Complete the mission objectives as they are given.
The trophy pops when the mission ends; no extra requirement.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, the airport takedown. A required story mission — finish it and the trophy pops. The airport itself matters for one more trophy later: the unscheduled departure at VCIA.

steps.t: Play the story until the VCIA Takedown mission appears.
Complete the mission objectives as they are given.
The trophy pops when the mission ends; remember the airport for Catch Me If You Can later.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. A required story mission — finish it when it comes up and the trophy pops with the mission end.

steps.t: Play the story until the Operation Savage Glory mission appears.
Complete the mission objectives as they are given.
The trophy pops when the mission ends; no extra requirement.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist — the gold trophy that usually unlocks last, right before the platinum. The threshold is forgiving: only about 60% true completion is needed, and the checklist itself only appears after the story (Progress, Stats, 100% Completion), though progress counts from the start. Optional missions that feed it can close mid-story, so do them when they appear.

steps.t: Do optional missions the moment they appear — some close mid-story and feed the checklist.
Fill the checklist loosely: for example 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals studied, 50 of 66 weapons, 70 of 80 challenges.
Finish in full: Robberies, Underwater Discoveries, Shooting Ranges, Drone Races and Bret's Quests — those must be complete.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, drifts and air time all count toward the total. It builds up naturally across the whole run, and the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep stunt-driving even after this pops.

steps.t: Stunt whenever you drive: jumps, near misses and drifts all feed the counter.
Track the count on this guide's stepper — the PSN counter runs to 250.
Keep going after 250 if you want 100%: the completion checklist counts 300 stunts.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. You do not need to win or master any of them — one attempt at each type is enough, so sample everything as soon as it unlocks.

steps.t: Open the activities list and note the 9 types; try each one at least once.
One attempt is enough per type — no win or gold medal is needed for this trophy.
The counter runs to 9; the trophy pops on the ninth type tried.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is the skill gate of the list — steady aim beats speed, and every challenge must be gold, not just finished. Shooting Ranges must also be fully complete for the 100% checklist.

steps.t: Visit the Shooting Range and work through the challenges one by one.
Replay any challenge below gold until it turns gold — all 42 must be gold.
The counter runs to 42; full completion also feeds A Long Road.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location needs its own win, so tour the map location by location and tick them off — drone races must also be fully complete for the 100% checklist.

steps.t: Find the Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations.
Win the race at each location — a win at one location does not cover the others.
The counter runs to 14; full completion also feeds A Long Road.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Replays of the same race do not count — each win must be a race you have not won before, so work through the race list instead of farming one favourite.

steps.t: Enter races across Leonida and win them.
Each win must be a different race — winning the same race twice adds nothing.
The counter runs to 20 different race wins.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the activities you can pick up along the way — challenge Cal, out-fish him, and the trophy pops.

steps.t: Take up fishing and find Cal's fishing challenge.
Beat Cal in the challenge — out-fish him on the day.
The trophy pops on the win; it can be retried if the first attempt fails.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Pick any arcade machine, play a game through to its end, and the trophy pops — no high score needed.

steps.t: Find an arcade machine and start any arcade game.
Play the game through to completion — no high score is required.
The trophy pops when the game ends.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Contact mission chains stay available after the story, but start each chain the moment its marker appears so nothing is left to the last minute.

steps.t: Start Andy's mission chain when his marker first appears.
Play through Andy's missions in order to the final one.
The trophy pops when Andy's final mission completes.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Work through his whole mission chain to the last mission — contact chains stay open after the story, so this can be finished in free roam.

steps.t: Start Kenton's mission chain when his marker first appears.
Play through Kenton's missions in order to the final one.
The trophy pops when Kenton's final mission completes.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Work through his whole mission chain to the last mission — contact chains stay open after the story, so this can be finished in free roam.

steps.t: Start Billy's mission chain when his marker first appears.
Play through Billy's missions in order to the final one.
The trophy pops when Billy's final mission completes.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. This is time-sensitive: the Chapter 3 race against Yago closes as the story moves on, so start every stranger marker the moment it appears instead of pushing the story forward.

steps.t: Start every stranger strand marker the moment it appears on the map.
Finish the Chapter 3 race against Yago before the story moves past it — it closes for good.
Complete 8 strands in total; the counter runs to 8.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Work through his whole mission chain to the last mission — contact chains stay open after the story, so this can be finished in free roam.

steps.t: Start Randy's mission chain when his marker first appears.
Play through Randy's missions in order to the final one.
The trophy pops when Randy's final mission completes.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Work through his whole mission chain to the last mission — contact chains stay open after the story, so this can be finished in free roam.

steps.t: Start Tyrone's mission chain when his marker first appears.
Play through Tyrone's missions in order to the final one.
The trophy pops when Tyrone's final mission completes.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida — 18 spots by the most complete count. This is the one possibly missable trophy: one spot in Chapter 1 disappears permanently after that chapter, so meditate the moment a spot appears and never skip the Chapter 1 spot.

steps.t: Meditate at every spot the moment you see it — the Chapter 1 spot is gone once that chapter ends.
Work through the full list of 18 spots across Leonida; the counter in this guide tracks 0/18.
If a list you follow counts only 15 spots, use the 18-spot list — the extra spots are the safe play until the count is settled.

dispute.title: SOURCES DISAGREE — both versions shown
dispute.a: Version A [1]: PowerPyx counts 18 meditation spots, and says one early spot in Chapter 1 is lost once that chapter ends.
dispute.b: Version B [2][5]: OutputLag and eGamers describe the early spot as Lucia's balcony in Chapter 1, and some lists count 15 spots rather than 18.
dispute.call: The two versions disagree on the count (18 vs 15) and on where the Chapter 1 spot is. This guide shows both and plays safe: meditate at every spot the moment you see it, and never skip the Chapter 1 spot.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunts are part of the side content — take the hunt, track the animal, and bring it down. Bret's quests must also be fully complete for the 100% checklist.

steps.t: Start Bret's hunt when his marker appears.
Track and hunt the unique animal Bret asks for.
The trophy pops when the hunt is done; finish all of Bret's quests for 100%.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are found across Leonida — collect them region by region and finish three full sets; a set only counts when every card in it is found.

steps.t: Collect cards as you explore each region of Leonida.
Finish a full set — a set counts only when every card in it is found.
Complete 3 sets in total; the counter runs to 3.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations across Leonida. Each location counts once, so keep moving — revisit nothing, and sweep region by region until the counter hits 100.

steps.t: WAiNK It at each location you pass — every new location counts once.
Sweep region by region so no area is left half-done.
The counter runs to 100 locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are scattered through every system in the game, so they pile up while you do everything else — the 100% checklist counts 70 of 80, so you can skip the hardest ones and still finish both.

steps.t: Take on challenges as they appear across activities, driving and combat.
Skip the hardest ones if they stall you — 70 of 80 is enough for 100%.
The counter runs to 50 completed challenges.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape. Build the heat together, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear — do it with your partner beside you, not solo.

steps.t: With your partner, raise your wanted level to 4 stars.
Break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the heat dies.
The trophy pops when the 4-star level is lost with your partner present.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. The chain breaks if the heat drops, so plan the route — three shops in a row, fast, with your partner, and do not let the stars clear between them.

steps.t: With your partner, pick three shops close together and plan the route.
Rob all three back-to-back, fast, without losing the wanted level between them.
The trophy pops on the third shop if the chain held.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. New vehicles count when you first find them, so scan every vehicle you pass while you play — the 100% checklist wants 200 of 277, so keep scanning long after this pops.

steps.t: Scan every new vehicle you pass while driving and on foot.
Only first discoveries count — the same model twice adds nothing.
The counter runs to 100; 100% needs 200 of 277.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with a crowd, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it ends — one use, five takedowns.

steps.t: Find a fight with at least five enemies grouped together.
Trigger Combat Focus and take down 5 enemies before it ends.
The trophy pops on the fifth takedown in that single use.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the airport. Get to the airport, take a plane, and leave without a schedule. The VCIA Takedown story mission shows you the airport first.

steps.t: Head to VCIA, the airport — the story mission VCIA Takedown takes you there first.
Take a plane and leave the airport without a scheduled departure.
The trophy pops when the unscheduled departure is made.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos — the tanks. Raise enough heat to bring the military out, then handle the Rhinos that roll in. High wanted levels are the way to meet them.

steps.t: Raise your wanted level high enough to bring out the Rhinos.
Engage the tanks that arrive — survive the encounter.
The trophy pops once the Rhino encounter is dealt with.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, take the goods, and get out before anyone spots you — detection fails the attempt, so plan the entry and the exit.

steps.t: Pick a jewelry store and plan a quiet entry and exit.
Rob the store without being detected at any point.
The trophy pops on a clean, undetected robbery.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. A vault only counts when you get away after it, so plan the escape as carefully as the robbery — five clean getaways in total.

steps.t: Find a bank vault and rob it.
Escape after each robbery — a vault counts only with the getaway.
Repeat for 5 vaults; the counter runs to 5.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Catch a truck on the road, stop it, take the takings, and get away before the response closes in.

steps.t: Find an armored truck on the road and stop it.
Rob the truck and take the takings.
Escape afterwards — the trophy pops on the getaway.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive and walk into every named area on the map — Vice City, the Keys, Port Gellhorn, Mount Kalaga, Grassrivers, Ambrosia, Hamlet and Yorktown — until the counter reads 52.

steps.t: Travel into every named area of Leonida — all 52 count.
Use this guide's map: sweep region by region so none is missed.
The counter runs to 52 explored areas.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. One operation per gang — find each gang's operation, hit it, and move on to the next gang until all nine are done.

steps.t: Find an illegal operation belonging to one gang and rob it.
Repeat for each of the other gangs — one operation per gang.
The counter runs to 9 gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Trigger not yet confirmed in public guides. What is known is only the official description: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The name suggests an early moment, so do it as early as you can — and do not trust any invented method until a guide confirms the trigger.

steps.t: What is known: the official description says only a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
PowerPyx lists this trophy's trigger as not yet known — no public source has confirmed how it fires.
Do it early on Ocean Beach if the chance appears, and check the sources again before grinding for it.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Trigger not yet confirmed in public guides. What is known is only the official description: smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Do not trust any invented method until a guide confirms the trigger.

steps.t: What is known: the official description says only a showroom smash-out in classic style.
PowerPyx lists this trophy's trigger as not yet known — no public source has confirmed how it fires.
Check the sources again during cleanup before chasing it.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to the alley, bowl a game, and see it through — the trophy is for the follow-through, not the score.

steps.t: Go to the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
Bowl a game and follow through to the end of it.
The trophy pops when the game is seen through.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal. The official description gives no location or method — only the theme of a partnership that draws a crowd. Treat it as a moment that surfaces during partner play, and check the guides again if it has not popped by cleanup.

steps.t: What is known: the official description says only a partnership with mass appeal.
No step-by-step method is published in the guides we read — play the partner content and watch for it.
If it has not popped by cleanup, re-check the guide sources for a confirmed trigger.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 choices across the game — the long counter that fills while you do everything else. Every decision counts toward it, for better or worse, so it finishes late in the run without any special farming.

steps.t: Keep making choices as you play — story, side content and activities all feed it.
Do not farm it early; the counter builds across the whole run.
The counter runs to 500 choices.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Trigger not yet confirmed in public guides. What is known is only the official description: second time's the charm. Do not trust any invented method until a guide confirms the trigger.

steps.t: What is known: the official description says only second time's the charm.
PowerPyx lists this trophy's trigger as not yet known — no public source has confirmed how it fires.
Check the sources again during cleanup before chasing it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Trigger not yet confirmed in public guides. What is known is only the official description: what the hell just happened? Something strange, somewhere in Leonida — but no public source has confirmed what, or where. Do not trust any invented method until a guide confirms the trigger.

steps.t: What is known: the official description says only what the hell just happened?
PowerPyx lists this trophy's trigger as not yet known — no public source has confirmed how it fires.
Check the sources again during cleanup before chasing it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Trigger not yet confirmed in public guides. What is known is only the official description: bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Do not trust any invented method until a guide confirms the trigger.

steps.t: What is known: the official description says only a melee drive-by that bowls people over.
PowerPyx lists this trophy's trigger as not yet known — no public source has confirmed how it fires.
Check the sources again during cleanup before chasing it.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies, and contacts clean them — keep robbing, keep laundering, and the total climbs to a quarter of a million.

steps.t: Collect Marked Bills from robberies and heists.
Launder them through your contacts — only laundered dollars count.
The counter runs to $250,000 laundered.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Every purchase in every shop counts toward the same total, so it builds up while you gear up — buy what you need and the trophy follows.

steps.t: Buy gear, clothes, weapons and supplies across all shops.
Every shop counts toward the same $100,000 total.
The counter runs to $100,000 spent.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages go on sale as you progress and earn — buy each one when it appears, and the trophy pops on the eighth.

steps.t: Earn money through missions, robberies and activities.
Buy each garage property as it becomes available.
The counter runs to 8 garage properties owned.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles worth keeping, register each one in the app, and the trophy pops on the tenth registration.

steps.t: Find vehicles across Leonida worth registering.
Register each one to the Scooter Bros app.
The counter runs to 10 vehicles registered.
